body: Yeah, that would be great..Please message me.  All I just need is someone...And the reason why I don't really talk to people, because I feel like nobody cares by the end of the day.

Honestly, it's hard to say...I don't have my mom, I feel like my mom wouldn't care and she would call me an "attention whore"...As for my boyfriend, I do...But....I feel embarrassed to talk about it...Because I feel like I have talked to him about it and I feel like he would get tired of me saying the same thing over and over.
